title: Ask2Web3
tagline: We are creating a community-based platform that will help users find solutions to their queries. Users will have the option to connect with the expert for that technology stack. Users can get vanity points and rewards based on their contributions.
description: Our purpose for this project is to provide a better platform for developers' queries and encourage developers to share their solutions so that someone can use them. We are going to create this project on the POLYGON network. Users can ask a question and use the best tag that describes the question. Any user can answer the question. Here, we will store all questions and answers on IPFS. We create a profile for each user. Based on their profile, users can directly send a message for a solution. Users must pay fees for that. For this direct communication, we are going to use XMTP. Users can vote for other questions and answers too. We will provide reputation points for posting questions, answers, articles, and voting. The user who is contributing more will get a POAP appreciation token. We will use the TABLELAND SQL service to store the titles of questions and answers for the search option. A user can publish an article that will help the community learn more about emerging technologies. We will have one page where users can see articles and crypto-related information. Users can also give tips to the articles. We will show crypto-related information using The GRAPH and COVALENT. Users can claim their rewards in their wallets. We are planning to host it using SPHERON. So this way, a community can help each other, and also earn reputation points, tokens, and rewards.
how_its_made:
We used multiple technologies for storing IPFS, for blockchain with less gas cost and high security we have used Polygon. 
We have used XMTP for allowing connection between question seeking users and the experts while allowing the experts to benefit financially for their time and experience.
Tableland, Spheron, POAP have been used to add feature on this web3 tech stack.
